regime_context: China A-shares thematic detector shows Tech (Semiconductors, AI Compute) dominating momentum ranks; 6 of 22 themes eligible, indicating narrow leadership. The absolute-trend gate historically did NOT reduce drawdown in this market (mean-reverting tape, gate_helps=false), so trend-following discipline is experimental here. No one-narrative dominance, and rotation display-only.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors show strong absolute trend (durability 0.69, Hurst trend, eligible), top momentum rank, and no crowding (z=0.61). The trend gate's historical failure in this market and rank-IC ~0 reduce confidence, but the current momentum structure supports an overweight direction as long as the trend remains intact.
evidence: abs_trend_gate not validating edge here, but still filtering eligible
theses.dissent: The absolute-trend gate whipsawed historically in A-shares, so trend continuation may be unreliable; any sudden mean-reversion could reverse the trend quickly.

falsifier.text: Semiconductors becomes ineligible (durability_bar drops below 0.5 or trend status flips to mean-revert/mixed) OR its rank falls out of top 2.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: While the trend is strong (durability 0.93, Hurst trend, breadth 1.0), crowding is elevated (z=1.39, flagged crowded). The crowding signal serves as a downsizing caution, suggesting the theme may be overbought relative to flow. As this is a leader but not the dominant narrative, an underweight lean reflects caution without fading the trend.
evidence: crowding has no basket-level drawdown edge, but warrants downsizing
theses.dissent: Crowded trends can persist and even accelerate; the strong durability and breadth suggest the trend could continue uninterrupted, making underweight a drag if the theme maintains momentum.

falsifier.text: Crowding_z drops below 1.0 (crowding flag cleared) and the theme remains eligible and in top-3 momentum rank.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
